system.description: This power is similar in appearance to the Intermediate power Ashes to Ashes, but is much more potent. Once you transform into a pile of heavy ashes, you retain complete control over all mental Disciplines except Dominate and Thaumaturgy. The dust cannot be forced apart or moved by the wind unless you so desire, and you can use winds to aid movement while in this form. Like characters employing Form of Mist, you retain cohesion without difficulty. To enter this form requires the expenditure of two Physical Traits.
